description: OVM distributeFunds routing, SplitV2 PullSplit distribution amounts, and the calls + per-recipient preview of splits.prepareDistribution. Routing: distributable = balance - fundsPendingWithdrawal; if distributable >= principalThresholdGwei * 1e9 and amountOfPrincipalStake > 0, principal = min(distributable, stake) and reward = the rest, else all reward. prepare cases give the chain state read at one block and expect the Multicall3 aggregate3 calls (in order, with allowFailure) and the preview; amounts are wei decimal strings.

provenance.sdk_ref: obol-sdk feat/sdk-2.16 working tree on 9297307 (staged, unreleased)
provenance.generated_by: scratch generator running src/splits/distribution.ts getOVMDistributionRouting, getSplitV2Distribution and prepareDistribution against a fake provider
provenance.note: The fake provider answers like test/splits/distribution.spec.ts makeChain (Hoodi addresses; test addresses stand in for the OVM and splits). Routing matches ObolValidatorManager._distributeFunds; the 1-wei rules match SplitsWarehouse.withdraw (balance - 1) and the PullSplit distribute amount used by 2.16 ((split balance - 1) + (warehouse balance - 1)), which was not re-checked against the SplitV2 source. Reason codes are the v3 codes; 2.16 threw InvalidArgumentError / ObolSdkError SPLIT_PAUSED.
provenance.rebaselined: 3.0.0-rc.4: the accepted prepare cases were re-run on the v3 prepareDistribution (VECTORS_REBASELINE=1 test/vectors/distribution.spec.ts) and every preview field is now compared. Deliberate differences from 2.16, recorded per case in notes: the default withdrawal set includes the Obol RAF address; the preview has minWithdraw, skipReason, distributorReward, fromThisDistribution and alreadyWaiting, and no toWallet or blockNumber; checks lists the finding codes.
